Here are three popular picks under ₹20,000. These are launch prices from my own knowledge, so today's price may differ.

Phone	Launch price	Chip	Battery and charging	Main camera
Redmi Note 13 5G	₹17,999	Dimensity 6080	5000 mAh, 33W	108 MP
Poco X6 5G	₹19,999	Snapdragon 7s Gen 2	5100 mAh, 67W	64 MP with stabilisation
Realme Narzo 70 Pro 5G	₹19,999	Dimensity 7050	5000 mAh, 67W	50 MP with stabilisation

For speed, the Poco X6 is the strongest. For the lowest price, go with the Redmi. For photos in low light, the Narzo's stabilised camera helps.

Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
7:15 PM

Here's an easy-paced 3 days with a long break after lunch each day. Opening hours and entry fees may have changed, so check before you go.

Day 1: Forts and old city

Morning: Amber Fort. Take a jeep up to the top to skip the steep climb.
Late morning: Quick photo stop at Jal Mahal.
Evening: Hawa Mahal, then an early dinner around Johari Bazaar.

Day 2: Palaces

Morning: City Palace and Jantar Mantar, which are close together.
Afternoon: Rest at the hotel.
Evening: Albert Hall Museum, which is lit up nicely after dark.

Day 3: Temples and shopping

Morning: Govind Dev Ji temple, then Birla Mandir.
Afternoon: Bapu Bazaar for block prints, jootis and jewellery.
Evening: Dinner at Chokhi Dhani for a village-style Rajasthani thali and folk show.

Oct to Mar is the best weather. Do your parents manage a lot of walking, or should I make it even gentler?
